1309-2225-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1309-2225-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2586-5147-7690--165.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat

250-779-1479-5226-7893.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5226-7893.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5226-7893.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

3179-4399-4476-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Answered Prayers trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4476-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2292-6461--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7606.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, it's innate ability and persist ability each trigger.
Resolve the trigger from Rampant Rejuvenator's innate ability, allowing you to search your library for a number of basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Rampant Rejuvenator from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3967-4276-5088-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
3967-4276-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
3967-4276-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Turnabout with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Turnabout.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2463-3259-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2463-3259-6965.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

140-2292-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
140-2292-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've lost X or more life this turn.
140-2292-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
140-2292-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2232-2792-5147-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-2792-5147-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.

2173-2292-4336-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

511-817-1636-2033.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
511-817-1636-2033.description:
Activate four creatures by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}{G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2034-3719-6188-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three creatures, excluding Fear of Missing Out, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Fear of Missing Out or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
2034-3719-6188-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping three creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Fear of Missing Out as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Luxurious Locomotive and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out, adding {C}{C}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

560-2425-2438-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2425-2438-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Smothering Abomination triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities.
Repeat.

38-2420-2486.notablePrerequisites:
Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
38-2420-2486.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander.
Repeat.

851-2523-4989.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
851-2523-4989.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Duke Ulder Ravengard triggers, giving Adrix and Nev haste and myriad until end of turn.
Declare Adrix and Nev as an attacker.
Adrix and Nev's myriad ability triggers, creating two token copies of Adrix and Nev that are tapped and attacking each opponent.
Put all Adrix and Nev tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Adrix and Nev tokens die, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev equal to 2^(the number of Adrix and Nevs you control) that are 2/2 Zombies.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.

1479-4826-5700-5701-5702.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4826-5700-5701-5702.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3705-4050-5695.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

2744-5641.notablePrerequisites: Basking Broodscale does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2744-5641.description:
Activate Basking Broodscale's adapt ability by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2816-3411-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Filigree Angel with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
